snippet.title: Toxoplasma | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4050580/

You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here. 

"Every day is a nightmare.

I wake up on this empty station and see things I know should not be there. I don't know if they're real, or hallucinations from the isolation, or if I've ended up infecting myself."

The world is falling apart. A rise of violence and misanthropy ravages the Earth, but your space station is not safe either. Every day you work towards a bio-weapon made to wipe out humanity in the most brutal way possible. Anyone who is contaminated hallucinates demonic entities that torment them until they die. You must finish its development before it kills you. You must fulfill your purpose.

Learn about the hidden conspiracy driving this apocalypse as you progress; create what will be the end of humanity, and survive the horrors of your own creation.
